items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: George Washington on trombone, Pedro Poenelle on alto, David Jones on tenor-sikes, Daniel Parker on guitar, he had Albert Morgan on bass

ctx.x: Who did Lee have with him?

Have a pretty good band? Oh yeah, yeah, good one. Yeah, George Washington on trombone, Pedro Poenelle on alto, David Jones on tenor-sikes, Daniel Parker on guitar, he had Albert Morgan on bass, and I think it was Roy on the drums though. I don't remember the drum player, but he had a good band. Regular New Orleans? Yeah, and he had the Joe Robichaud.
Regular New Orleans band though up there, huh?
